builds.howItPlays: You kill enemy units with Hidden Blade and Wages of Pain, a 3-cost spell that deals 3 to a unit and also gives you a Gold token, while Card Sharp and Renata's own holding ability add more Gold that you can cash in later for an extra rune. That Gold pays for Vanguard Armory, a 7-cost gear that makes three 1-Might units each turn (or Jayce, Man of Progress puts it into play for free), and those units hold battlefields until you reach 8 points.
builds.whyYou: You like answering your opponent's units one by one and saving up for a bigger turn later. You don't mind playing few units early, because every Gold token you bank now becomes an extra rune later, and once you're within 3 points of winning each one pays out more. You enjoy tracking your Gold and picking the right turn to spend it. If a patient game that ends with a flood of small units holding the board sounds more fun than a fast start, this Renata suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Changed 2026-09-25 (re-rate from the deck picks, style Vanguard Armory Gold, the lead agent's merge confirmed in the picks): relabelled Combo to Control and coordinates moved from 5.5/6.5/8.5/7.5 to 3/3.5/7/4 (pace/stance/complexity/variance), the mean of three scored decks from tools.ts style. Every Axis moved 1.5 or more (Stance 3, Variance 3.5). The old Build came from guide quotes about an early-race, one-big-turn plan. The current lists run 15 to 21 answers, tag no engine cards and trade removal for units while they bank Gold, so they are removal-heavy and steady, not a swingy combo. The label is the tool's majority (Control, Control, Midrange), which matches the picks. deckListUrl moved from the bare /decks page to the Utrecht RQ Best of list, the style's first deck. All three old guideUrls were dropped: they describe the old Combo framing and were not re-read for this list. The scored deck pages replace them. Scored decks: 【Regional Qualifier】Utrecht - Best of Renata Glasc (Evox 13) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f8c41b02-4510-436e-ae15-0c42b0d6d52e Control 3/3.5/7/3.5 (15 answers, 13 reactive, 13 cards costing 5+). Renata (Eli Jason) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/ea0171da-5033-40e5-b3ea-e2f88d6597ad Control 3/3/7/4 (21 answers). Best of Sydney - Renata Glasc | Dois | 2026 RQ https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/18f129f7-4225-4db2-b9a8-1f4f35b4775c Midrange 3.5/4.5/7/4 (Plundering Poro, Sprite Fountain and World Atlas give it more pressure, and it has 11 answers). Adjustment on every sheet: complexity +0.5, because the Legend's hold trigger banks Gold and its near-victory bonus changes when to spend it. Cards that decided each Axis. Pace: 12 to 14 units and 10 to 14 cards costing 5+ (Vanguard Armory, Hostile Takeover, Thousand-Tailed Watcher, Time Warp). Stance: Hidden Blade, Wages of Pain, Cull the Weak, Bellows Breath, Singularity, Imperial Decree and Hostile Takeover against only 3 to 7.5 pressure cards. Complexity: 10 to 13 Hidden and reaction-speed spells, plus Jayce killing a Gold to put in Vanguard Armory for free. Variance: no luck or swing cards, and 53 to 68 percent of cards run as 3-ofs. No sheet had a formula-judgment gap of 2+. Legend ability: when you or an ally hold, you may exhaust Renata to play a Gold gear token exhausted, and while your score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, your Gold adds an additional 1 Energy. Champion: Renata Glasc, Mastermind (5 cost, draws a card or scores a point while at a battlefield). Also played: Alex F, Renata 92% winrate https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f9c01c4a-e9ea-4f2e-9eb6-4a5c4b5af568 (merged into this style, Karthus/Soaring Scout flex, unscored; the winrate claim is unverified). Other ways to play it, whose decks join this Build: Karthus Deathknell Aristocrats https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/b80360fc-bc48-4829-a6a2-47ba11c04591 (Midrange 4.5/4/7.5/4.5) and https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f7b7e198-b140-4375-9e7e-074391b9d9ea (Control 4/3.5/7.5/4.5); Pit Crew Gear Renata https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/aaed29fd-6242-48da-b1d0-40478ba8493c (Singapore RQ Best of 2026-09-10, Midrange 4.5/5.5/7/4.5); Blue Sentinel Gold Hold https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/131b0fcb-0140-4e41-8bda-5f28a5e5ad76 (Midrange 4/4.5/7.5/5). Confidence: low. Reviewer check: the bar was loosened, with three fair decks from different authors and no strong one. All three scored lists come from the Unleashed era (May-June RQs), and only Alex F's unscored list is from after Vendetta. The newest RQ result (Singapore, Pit Crew Gear) is 2 apart on Stance but has one player behind it, so it stays folded in until more lists appear.
